title: Global Patterns of Knowledge: Language, Genre, and the Geography of Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Applying Economic Complexity Analysis and calculating Revealed Comparative Advantage (RCA) on the editing histories of over 150 Wikipedia language editions to quantify structural imbalances, comparative advantages, and specializations in knowledge production across different linguistic communities.

Mapping the viewership-weighted Economic Complexity Index (ECI) to specific countries and regressing these indices against national economic indicators (such as GNI per capita and R&D expenditure) to evaluate global disparities and structural imbalances in knowledge consumption and production.

Evaluating structural similarities and fragmentation in editorial behavior across different knowledge domains by contrasting culturally-bound topics (e.g., Cooking, Controversies, Conspiracy Theories) with globally standardized topics (e.g., Science, STEM).
